CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnObtenerTotalConceptos](@Membresia_Id INT) 
RETURNS DECIMAL(18,2)  
AS  
BEGIN    
    DECLARE @retval DECIMAL(18,2);   

	SELECT 
		@retval = SUM(ISNULL(cmb.Cantidad, 0) * ISNULL(cfac.PrecioUnitario, 0)) 
	FROM ConceptoIncluidoMembresia cmb
	LEFT JOIN ConceptoFacturable cfac 
		ON cmb.ConceptoFacturable_Id = cfac.Id
	WHERE 
		cmb.IncluidoEnlaMembresia = 0
	AND cmb.Activo = 1
	AND Membresia_Id = @Membresia_Id    

    RETURN @retval
END;
